name: @repo/load
description: k6 load tests against a running API (see api.ts).

scripts.test:load: turbo run load:users --filter=@repo/api && bun --env-file=../.env run docker run --rm --memory=512m --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "$PWD":/load -w /load -e BASE_URL -e API_PORT -e PROFILE -e TARGET_RPS -e DURATION grafana/k6:2.3.0 run api.ts
